intent: Two alternative Progress-screen design previews; no application code changed.
data_notice: All measurements and counts are illustrative mock data, not account data.

concepts.title: 方案 A｜变化优先
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native mobile product UI design, a single full-bleed portrait iPhone screenshot, approximately 1024 x 2176 proportions.
Primary request: redesign the Progress / 趋势 screen of the gentle weight-management companion app 称小二. The user wants genuinely different information layout choices, not a recolored old dashboard.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY the approved Home screen STYLE AND BRAND REFERENCE, NOT an edit target. Carry over its illustration-free clean interface, app icon, visual vocabulary, typography and bottom tab bar; replace all Home screen content with this Progress screen.
Brand: exact simplified Chinese name "称小二" (first character 称). Friendly ivory weighing scale inside an apricot rounded-square icon. Warm white #FBF9F6 canvas, deep navy #14204C text, indigo #303E79 and #4B588E, apricot #FBC098, peach #FFE5D5, lavender #EEEFFC, powder blue #E0EFF8, pale yellow #FFF0C2, orange #CE4E09, slate #73798B. White softly rounded cards, tiny soft shadows, clear Chinese sans-serif, balanced large numbers, airy polished but useful layout. No old forest green.
Fixed shell: native iOS status bar "18:50", compact brand header with scale icon + "称小二" left and small peach "已同步" pill right. Bottom fixed white tab bar with "今天", "教练", "趋势", "我的"; ONLY 趋势 selected with indigo rounded-square icon backplate and apricot line graph glyph. Respect top and bottom safe areas with home indicator. No physical device frame, no mockup backdrop, no external headings, no option labels embedded in the app, no comparison collage, no watermark, no floating debug gear.
Shared illustrative data for BOTH concepts: selected rolling "近 7 天", alternative "近 30 天", date range "10/23 — 10/29". Body weight measurements 10/23=79.6, 10/24=79.4, 10/26=79.5, 10/27=79.2, 10/29=79.0 kg. Dates 10/25 and 10/28 have NO measurement. Latest weight 79.0 kg. First-to-last change −0.6 kg, label "较本期首次" (NOT compared to prior week). Record counts: "体重" 5 条, "体脂" 0 条, "饮食" 12 条, "运动" 3 条. These are record counts, not consecutive days or adherence rates.
Constraints: Do not invent calories, BMI, health score, rankings, prediction, diagnosis, streak pressure, target completion rings, body-fat values, or meal/exercise daily histories. Missing data stays missing. Only actually observed weights are dots/entries. All text must be clean legible simplified Chinese, require accurate stated values. Do not copy the Home giant motivational headline or Home action grid. No explanatory paragraphs or tiny disclaimers filling the page.
Design direction A — chart-first / change-first, contemporary calm data dashboard.
Layout top to bottom:
1. Under compact brand header, a concise big navy page heading "趋势" with a small subtitle "把变化，看清楚。" Not a huge multi-line hero. A compact pill segmented period switch "近 7 天" selected / "近 30 天", and the date range in slate below.
2. Main dominant WHITE chart card with header tabs "体重" selected / "体脂" inactive. Inside card top left, small "最近测量" followed by very large navy "79.0" with smaller "kg". At right a small peach summary pill "−0.6 kg" and a slate label below "较本期首次".
3. This card's major central area is an elegant substantial indigo line chart on white with very faint horizontal grids. Sensible y labels 80.0, 79.5, 79.0, 78.5. Show five accurate points at their calendar-spaced dates across 10/23 to 10/29, with a small real upward bump 79.4 to 79.5, not a perfectly falling line. Final point highlighted apricot with subtle callout "79.0". No fabricated points on 10/25 or 10/28. Show x labels 10/23, 10/25, 10/27, 10/29. Minimal light lavender area tint below the curve, not a heavy gradient. Chart stays plausible, natural, restrained. Footer in card "每天保留最新测量" and a compact outline plus-button "记一笔".
4. Lower section heading "这 7 天，记下了". A compact two-by-two set of record-count tiles: apricot scale icon / "体重" / "5 条"; lavender heart icon / "体脂" / "0 条"; powder-blue cutlery / "饮食" / "12 条"; pale-yellow walking icon / "运动" / "3 条". White tiles with only colored icon patches, not four full strong background blocks. Clear hierarchy and normal touch targets.
5. Small quiet text near bottom "体重会有日常波动，慢慢看趋势。" No judgment or fake coach insight.
Make all these parts visible above fixed tabs in one usable screen, polished spacing at the same density as the reference. A true chart-centered redesign, not a stacked form of two huge segmented controls.

Design direction B — record-journal / measurement-rhythm-first. This is structurally different from a chart dashboard: NO large line chart. Use a calm period report with day selection and a clean daily weight ledger as the dominant content.
Layout top to bottom:
1. Under compact brand header, big concise navy heading "记录与变化". On the next row, compact "近 7 天" selected / "近 30 天" switch, and slate date range "10/23 — 10/29". Do not add a giant inspirational headline.
2. A wide horizontal INDIGO summary card, gently rounded, with subtle tonal arc borrowed from the Home indigo card. Split into two visually calm columns: left label "本期首次", value "79.6 kg"; right label "最近测量", value "79.0 kg". Bottom a thin soft divider then a small apricot inline label "本期首末变化 −0.6 kg". No arrows suggesting obligation, no percentage, no target progress ring. Balanced white typography, latest slightly more prominent.
3. Main large WHITE journal card headed "体重" selected with a discreet "体脂" text tab beside it, and a slim plus action "记一笔" at right. Then a seven-day selection ribbon, dates 23,24,25,26,27,28,29 in a row. Only 23,24,26,27,29 have small indigo measurement dots; 25 and28 are quiet outlines with no data, not zero. Selected29 has apricot fill. Caption "10月 · 有测量的日子" in small slate. The ribbon represents weight measurement dates ONLY, not diet/exercise adherence. 
4. Within the same journal card below ribbon, simple vertical timeline or spacious ledger rows for actual observed dates, newest first: "10/29" with "79.0 kg", "10/27" with "79.2 kg", "10/26" with "79.5 kg". Each row has a subtle indigo dot, small neutral label "体重", large right-aligned value, thin separators. Footer "查看全部 5 条" with chevron. No fabricated time of day and no motivational badges. This chronological ledger is the focal interaction, not a chart. Dates and values must be precisely rendered.
5. Lower compact section heading "同期记录". A single white rounded strip divided into four columns with tiny colored outline icons and exact text: "体重 5条", "体脂 0条", "饮食 12条", "运动 3条". Quiet balanced layout, not a big dashboard grid. All are record counts, not unique-day counts.
Make all visible above bottom tabs at practical touch-friendly size. This should feel like a warm modern measurement journal, clearly distinct in layout from a large chart-centric dashboard while perfectly matching the Home brand.
